option_relations.rationale: Hemorrhagic Fever with Renal Syndrome (HFRS) is a component of the more specific diagnosis of HFRS due to HTNV with concurrent COVID-19 infection.
COVID-19 is a component of the more specific diagnosis of HFRS due to HTNV with concurrent COVID-19 infection.
Acute Kidney Injury is a known manifestation of Hemorrhagic Fever with Renal Syndrome, which is part of the leaf diagnosis.

Coinfection of Hantaan virus (HTNV) and SARS-CoV-2 directly corresponds to 'Hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome (HFRS) due to Hantaan virus (HTNV) with concurrent COVID-19 infection' as HFRS is caused by Hantaan virus.
